name: Panic
rule: Roll the Panic Die and try to roll above your current Stress.

results.name: Adrenaline Rush
results.effect: [+] on all rolls for the next 2d10 minutes. Reduce Stress by 1d5.

results.name: Nervous
results.effect: Gain 1 Stress.

results.name: Jumpy
results.effect: Gain 1 Stress. All Close crewmembers gain 2 Stress.

results.name: Overwhelmed
results.effect: [-] on all rolls for the next 1d10 minutes. Increase Minimum Stress by 1.

results.name: Coward
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: You must make a Fear Save to engage in violence, otherwise you flee.

results.name: Frightened
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: When encountering what frightened you, make a Fear Save [-] or gain 1d5 Stress.

results.name: Nightmares
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: Sleep is difficult, gain [-] on Rest Saves.

results.name: Loss Of Confidence
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: Choose one Skill and lose that Skill's bonus.

results.name: Deflated
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: Whenever a Close crewmember fails a Save, gain 1 Stress.

results.name: Doomed
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: You feel cursed and unlucky. All Critical Successes are instead Critical Failures.

results.name: Suspicious
results.effect: For the next week, whenever someone joins the crew (even if they only left for a short period of time), make a Fear Save or gain 1 Stress.

results.name: Haunted
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: Something starts visiting the character at night. In their dreams. Out of the corner of their eye. And soon it will start making demands.

results.name: Death Wish
results.effect: For the next 24 hours, whenever encountering a stranger or known enemy, make a Sanity Save or immediately attack them.

results.name: Prophetic Vision
results.effect: Character immediately experiences an intense hallucination or vision of an impending terror or horrific event. Increase Minimum Stress by 2.

results.name: Catatonic
results.effect: Become unresponsive and unmoving for 2d10 minutes. Reduce Stress by 1d10.

results.name: Rage
results.effect: [+] on all Damage rolls for the next 1d10 hours. All crewmembers gain 1 Stress.

results.name: Spiraling
results.effect: Gain a new Condition: Panic Checks are at [-].

results.name: Compounding Problems
results.effect: Roll twice on this table. Increase your Minimum Stress by 1.

results.name: Heart Attack / Short Circuit (Androids)
results.effect: Reduce Maximum Wounds by 1. Gain [-] on all rolls for 1d10 hours. Increase Minimum Stress by 1.

results.name: Retire
results.effect: Roll up a new character to play.
